hooks.text: The largest structure ever built in space is being destroyed.
Humanity's greatest space station is being steered into the sea.
A football-field-sized space station will plunge into the ocean.

title: The Biggest Thing in Space Is Headed for the Ocean
description: Humanity's largest orbital outpost spans the size of a football field. Around 2030, NASA plans to steer the entire space station into the sea.

beats.text: The largest structure ever built in space is being destroyed.
beats.visual: Photograph of the International Space Station flying over Earth, STS-132, 2010.

beats.text: The International Space Station spans 109 meters, rivaling a football field.
beats.visual: Exterior view showing full length of International Space Station truss, STS-134, 2011.
queries: International Space Station full view STS-134

beats.text: Inside, its pressurized volume matches a Boeing 747 airliner.
beats.visual: Astronaut inside the Destiny laboratory module on the International Space Station, 2001.

beats.text: Fifteen nations partnered together to assemble it piece by piece.
beats.visual: First two modules Zarya and Unity joined together in orbit, STS-88, 1998.

beats.text: Humans have lived aboard the station continuously since November 2000.
beats.visual: Expedition 1 crew inside the International Space Station, 2000.

beats.text: It orbits 250 miles high, circling Earth every 90 minutes.
beats.visual: Earth viewed through the seven windows of the ISS Cupola module, 2010.
queries: Cupola module looking down on Earth

beats.text: Yet NASA plans to end operations around 2030.
beats.visual: International Space Station passing over the blue Earth limb at sunset, 2021.

beats.text: A dedicated deorbit craft will steer the massive complex into the ocean.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a spacecraft deorbiting through the upper atmosphere, 2024.

beats.text: No human construction in orbit has ever matched it.
beats.visual: Wide view of the complete International Space Station against deep black space, 2018.
queries: International Space Station from Soyuz MS-08

better_than_last: Applies the record structure with a sub-10-word opening hook and escalates through physical scale comparisons before hitting the planned deorbit payoff.
